text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (August 20, 2024) for 53-57 Widdicombe Hill Boulevard.

The Property Standards Committee – Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (August 20, 2024) for 53-57 Widdicombe Hill Boulevard, Folder Number 24 199999 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to September 30, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
